sourceChecked: Georgia Drivers' Manual 2023-2024 (dds.georgia.gov/document/document/ga-drivers-manual-2023-2024/download, latest linked from the DDS manuals page); MUTCD 2023

issues: Note only: 'Half of the Georgia knowledge exam is the Road Signs test, and it is given in English only.' → matches manual (Road Signs 20 questions + Road Rules 20 questions, signs test in English only) → Manual p.12

Note only: concept 'A plate under the crossbuck shows the number of tracks.' → MUTCD uses the plate only where there are two or more tracks; summary already says 'sometimes'. Consider 'may show' for consistency → MUTCD R15-2P

Note only: BAC card 'Driving a commercial motor vehicle at 0.04 or more leads to disqualification.' → fact is correct (O.C.G.A. 40-6-391(i); 49 CFR 383.51) but the cited Georgia Drivers' Manual (DUI section) does not state 0.04; consider citing the Georgia CDL Manual / O.C.G.A. 40-6-391
Note only (all chapters): sources say year 2026 but the current manual linked from DDS is the 2023-2024 edition; all checked numbers match that edition

sign-shapes.note: Octagon/triangle/upright and wide rectangle/diamond/pentagon (fluorescent yellow-green)/round RR match MUTCD shapes and colors; matches alt and summary.

railroad-crossing-signs.note: W10-1 round sign, R15-1 crossbuck with R15-2P '2 TRACKS' plate, and RXR pavement marking correct; matches compare table and caption.

center-line-types.note: Right-hand traffic orientation correct (southbound on left, northbound on right); in panel 2 the broken line is on the southbound side, so label 'Passing only from the broken-line side' is right; consistent with compare table.
